title: Tutankhamun’s famous dagger came from a meteorite; A hidden pattern in the blade reveals how ancient Egyptians forged it
description: King Tutankhamun’s famous iron dagger was made from a meteorite. Now, a hidden crystalline pattern inside its blade has revealed how ancient Egyptian craftsmen worked with metal from space thousands of years ago.
